authority_notice: This file is an explicit contract-debt register, not a contract and not a modification of contracts/**. cloud-in-school/contracts remains the sole authoritative contract surface. Records are retained for audit even after the contract line closes them.

debts.resolution_evidence: contracts/schemas/plugin-extension-v2.schema.json is now the runtime-shaped snake_case dis-extension/v2 schema and registers the declarative command target fields; the transitional non-contract schema mirror was removed after runtime switched to the contract schema.
contracts/compatibility/host-api-matrix.yaml host_api 2 now lists exactly the six runtime-supported v2 slots and dynamic_code_loading_allowed=false.

The 58 runtime plugin manifest fixtures were migrated byte-for-byte into contracts/fixtures/plugins/{valid,invalid}/ as the shared authoritative fixture set; the non-contract fixture mirrors were removed from cloud and Android test resources.

PluginInstallRequest now requires only the signed manifest, registers canonical artifact_map and school_id, removes detached signature evidence, and documents public_key_base64 strictly as an optional consistency proof rather than trust input.

PluginLifecycleRequest and response schemas now register account/school scoped lifecycle fields, REVOKE_PERMISSION, rollback target_version, admin kill-switch isolation output, and restart-time QUARANTINED evidence fields.

PluginCommandInvokeRequest now uses canonical payload/requested_origin/school_id scope selection, removes campus_profile_id and input from the published shape, and the invoke response documents non-echo declarative output.
